page.layout: One printed page, single block of verse lines in the centre; running head at top centre; page number at top right; a small mark "G. p" below the text, centred. No margin notes.

p.i: Saltus quum peteret mens vaga devios
Nec si per trepidas luctifica manu
Formidem duce te pergere: me pedo
Gens sancta Dominum colite: nil deerit Deum

main_text.p: Et Psal. 37. agens de fidelibus & viris bonis.

page.notes: Marginal and mid-line marks on the scan are not transcribed as notes. Doubtful readings: "Tu" in the verse lines, "Et Psal. 37." and the line "Linquent sua propaginis" are read from a faint scan. The printed "G. p" mark below the text is uncertain.
